perseverance.text: I can do all things through him who strengthens me.

kjv.text: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.

perseverance.text: But they who wait for the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings like eagles.

clarity.text: If any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask God, who gives generously to all without reproach.

growth.text: Grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.

love.text: Love is patient and kind; love does not envy or boast.

self-worth.text: I praise you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made.

perseverance.text: Indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.

clarity.text: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

growth.text: Indeed, Allah will not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves.

love.text: The believers are but brothers, so make settlement between your brothers.

self-worth.text: We have certainly created man in the best of stature.

perseverance.text: Wait for the Lord; be strong, and let your heart take courage.

clarity.text: Trust in the Lord with all your heart, and do not lean on your own understanding.

growth.text: What does the Lord require of you? To do justice, love kindness, and walk humbly.

love.text: You shall love your neighbor as yourself.

self-worth.text: You have made them a little lower than the heavenly beings and crowned them with glory and honor.

perseverance.text: You have a right to perform your duty, but not to the fruits of action.

clarity.text: Elevate yourself through the power of your mind, and do not degrade yourself.

growth.text: Through practice and detachment, the mind can be restrained.

love.text: One who is not envious but is a kind friend to all beings is dear to Me.

self-worth.text: You are what your deep, driving desire is. As your desire is, so is your will.

perseverance.text: To cease from evil, to do good, and to purify the mind — this is the teaching of the awakened ones.

clarity.text: Let one find joy in vigilance; the wise guard the mind.

growth.text: You yourselves must strive; the Buddhas only point the way.

love.text: May all beings be happy and secure; may their hearts be wholesome.

self-worth.text: Greater in battle than the man who conquers a thousand times a thousand is the one who conquers himself.

perseverance.text: With your own hands carve your destiny.

clarity.text: Where there is truth, there is righteousness; where there is righteousness, there is divine bliss.

growth.text: As one learns, so one teaches; as one sows, so one reaps.

love.text: No one is my enemy, and no one is a stranger. I get along with everyone.

self-worth.text: Recognize the divine light within all; do not consider anyone inferior.

perseverance.text: You have power over your mind — not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.

clarity.text: We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.

growth.text: No great thing is created suddenly.

love.text: It is not our differences that divide us. It is our inability to recognize and celebrate those differences.

self-worth.text: For small creatures such as we, the vastness is bearable only through love.

perseverance.text: The light you seek is already within you — keep walking toward it.

clarity.text: Still the mind, and the path ahead becomes clearer.

growth.text: Every step forward, however small, reshapes who you become.

love.text: Where compassion grows, the heart finds its true strength.

self-worth.text: You are already whole — your journey is to remember that.
